what: All grid cells start gathered at the center of the screen at 0 scale, then spread one by one in shuffled order at .05s intervals, growing to their places over 2s power3.out — later cells overlap on top. The blur target inside each cell starts at 6px blur and clears over .5s after .75s. An entrance where a Hero made of dozens of work cells bursts out from the center

options.delay: Time before the first cell departs (sec), default .2 — if a loader comes before, use its length
options.dur: Duration of one cell spreading (s), default 2
options.clear: Time (s) until the cell departs and the blur starts to clear, default .75
options.[data-fx-part=blur]: (Optional) Panel where the blur clears inside the box
options.fx:spread: Event fired by the panel when it attaches — detail.end is when the last cell settles (sec). Align later effects such as cell line drawing to it

note: Cell positions are measured once at the moment of attaching, so the grid width must be set before attaching (fits square grids whose cell size does not change when fonts arrive late)

from.where: index.html #grid — original ProjectGrid.openPage: each cell raises zIndex at 200 + K×50ms, then animateOpen (screen center x · y, scale 0 → in place 1, 2s power3.out · blur-wrap 6px → 0 for .75s then .5s none), order via gsap.utils.shuffle
